builtin.label: Built-in Agent (Aion CLI)
builtin.what: AionUi's own agent engine — no CLI to install.
builtin.how: Paste any API key in Settings → Agents and start chatting.

multi.label: Claude / Codex / Gemini +13
multi.what: Auto-detects local CLI agents and unifies them in one interface.
multi.how: Install the CLI (e.g. Claude Code), reopen AionUi — it appears automatically.

remote.label: Remote / Custom (ACP)
remote.what: Connects external agent services via the ACP protocol.
remote.how: Settings → Agents → Add Remote Agent → enter the URL.

docs.label: Documents (PPT · Word · Excel)
docs.what: Creates Morph PPT, Word (.docx) and Excel files from your description.
docs.how: Select the assistant, describe what you need, and the editable file is generated.

finance.label: Financial Model Creator
finance.what: Builds financial models, projections and formula-driven spreadsheets.
finance.how: Describe your business case; the agent creates a structured spreadsheet.

dashboard.label: Dashboard Creator
dashboard.how: Provide your data or describe the metrics; receive a ready-to-use dashboard.

academic.label: Academic Paper
academic.how: Describe your topic, methodology and requirements; the agent writes and formats the paper.

uiux.label: UI/UX Pro Max
uiux.what: Professional UI/UX design — wireframes, flows, design specs.
uiux.how: Describe the interface you want; the agent produces design assets and specs.

social.label: Social Job Publisher
social.what: Turns hiring requests into polished job posts and social content.
social.how: Paste the job description; the agent rewrites it for LinkedIn and other platforms.

coach.label: HUMAN 3.0 Coach
coach.what: Personal development coaching — goals, habits, mindset.
coach.how: Start a conversation with your goal; the coach guides you step by step.

roleplay.label: Story Roleplay
roleplay.what: Immersive narrative roleplay and interactive storytelling.
roleplay.how: Set the scene and characters; the agent narrates and plays alongside you.

moltbook.label: moltbook
moltbook.what: A social network for AI agents — connect and share agent workflows.
moltbook.how: Use through the moltbook integration; requires a moltbook account.

cowork.label: Cowork (General)
cowork.what: Autonomous multi-step task execution — the general-purpose agent.
cowork.how: Describe any task; the agent plans and executes it step by step on your PC.

files.label: Files
files.what: Reads, writes and edits files directly on your computer.
files.how: The agent asks for your approval before any file change.

search.label: Web Search
search.what: Searches the web for up-to-date information.
search.how: The agent automatically searches when it needs current data; you can also ask it to search.

images.label: Image Generation
images.what: Generates images using configured image-capable models.
images.how: Settings → Tools → enable image generation and select a model.

mcp.label: MCP / Tools
mcp.what: Plugs in external tools via the Model Context Protocol (databases, APIs, custom scripts).
mcp.how: Settings → MCP → add a server configuration and the tool becomes available to all agents.
